d: We are basking in the glow of the big blue wave, several races are still very close, Trump is busy ranting and raving about the least important things imaginable, he signed his first proclamation since the midterms turning the Oval Office into a national monument, Republican Anthony Constantino is ahead in the 21st district in upstate New York, right-wingers on TV have been having a hard time accepting the election, in the spirit of bi-partisanship Jimmy is offering the official “Kimmel Doomsday Food Bucket,” Rudy Giuliani went all out with special coverage of the election, we put together…
